name: Qualcomm AI Hub
tagline: Qualcomm AI Hub helps developers optimize, validate, profile, and deploy machine learning models on Qualcomm devices. It provides hardware-aware model conversion, cloud-hosted device testing, and a catalog of optimized models for on-device vision, audio, speech, and generative AI.
